sources.snippet: 2. Model Merging (merge_models.py) For merging multiple full checkpoints (e.g., merging two different SFT runs or a DPO model with an SFT model), the repository uses merge_models.py. Linear Weight Averaging merge_models.py performs a simple weighted average of safetensors files.

sources.title: Model merging · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model merging offers a solution to these challenges by combining multiple pretrained models into one model, giving it the combined abilities of each individual model without any additional training. PEFT provides several methods for merging models like a linear or SVD combination.
